description: The HP-61 RTO is the Regional Transport Office for the Kullu district, primarily responsible for the registration of commercial vehicles and the issuance of transport permits. Unlike Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) offices that handle private vehicle registrations (like HP-34), HP-61 functions at the district level for enforcement and regulatory transport matters. It serves as a vital hub for managing the high volume of commercial tourist traffic and freight within the Kullu valley.
address: Regional Transport Office, Kullu District Headquarters, Kullu, Himachal Pradesh
